title: Version engineering governance and traceability
summary: Add repository-owned contributor, review, release-note, ADR, and machine-readable change contracts with a required Rust validation gate.

risk.failure_mode: An incorrect validator or stale cross-file contract can block every pull request or allow incomplete traceability.
risk.rollback: Revert the M0-012 functional commits together so the workflow and canonical gate list remain consistent.

compatibility.detail: No emulator runtime, media, API, or persisted configuration behavior changes.

security.detail: Contributor and evidence contracts explicitly reject credentials, copyrighted media, private endpoints, and local filesystem paths.

tests.proves: Task IDs, Markdown contracts, path confinement, and private-path detection fail closed.
Every required contract and cross-file traceability link validates and the evidence bundle has exact checksums.
Governance composes with every existing host, compatibility, supply-chain, portable, and firmware gate.

evidence.proves: Required contracts, ADRs, release notes, change records, source revision, and checksums are machine readable.
